Threat: Compromised admin credentials leading to full environment takeover
Vulnerability: No mandatory MFA enforced on all privileged accounts
Treatment Action: Enforce MFA on all IAM privileged accounts; implement break-glass procedure with logging

Threat: Unauthorized access to KYC documents due to misconfigured bucket policy
Vulnerability: S3 bucket permissions not centrally reviewed; no automated drift detection
Treatment Action: Implement AWS Config rules + quarterly access review of all S3 buckets holding PII

Threat: Man-in-the-middle attack on payment data in transit
Vulnerability: TLS configuration not independently verified on all internal service-to-service calls
Treatment Action: Enforce TLS 1.2+ across all internal service mesh traffic; automate cert rotation

Threat: Malware/ransomware via phishing leading to data exfiltration
Vulnerability: No centrally managed EDR solution deployed fleet-wide
Treatment Action: Deploy EDR across all corporate endpoints; mandatory security awareness training

Threat: Vendor data breach exposing ExampleOrg customer identity data
Vulnerability: No formal vendor security assessment conducted prior to onboarding
Treatment Action: Conduct retrospective vendor risk assessment; add breach notification clause to DPA

Threat: Former employee retains system access after termination
Vulnerability: Access revocation not automated; relies on manual HR-to-IT handoff
Treatment Action: Integrate Darwinbox HRMS with IAM for automated access deprovisioning

Threat: Backup data exposed due to lack of encryption at rest
Vulnerability: Some legacy backup snapshots predate encryption-by-default policy
Treatment Action: Audit and re-encrypt all legacy backup snapshots; enforce encryption in backup policy

Threat: Secrets/API keys committed to code accidentally
Vulnerability: No automated secret-scanning enabled on private repos
Treatment Action: Enable GitHub secret scanning + pre-commit hooks across all repos

Threat: Support agent views/exports customer data beyond job need
Vulnerability: Role-based access control not granular; broad access granted by default
Treatment Action: Implement least-privilege RBAC roles in Salesforce; quarterly access recertification

Threat: Accidental public exposure of internal dashboards or admin panels
Vulnerability: No periodic external attack surface scan performed
Treatment Action: Implement quarterly external attack surface scanning (ASM tool)

Threat: Delayed breach detection and regulatory notification (RBI/DPDP timelines missed)
Vulnerability: No formal incident response plan or defined escalation path exists
Treatment Action: Formalize and approve Incident Response Policy; run tabletop exercise

Threat: Extended platform outage during regional AWS disruption
Vulnerability: No documented BCP/DR plan or tested failover procedure
Treatment Action: Draft BCP with defined RTO/RPO; conduct annual DR test

Asset: Employee personal devices (BYOD for email access)
Threat: Data leakage via unmanaged personal devices accessing corporate email
Vulnerability: No Mobile Device Management (MDM) policy enforced
Treatment Action: Deploy MDM with conditional access policy for mobile email

Threat: KYC vendor retains customer data beyond contractual/legal requirement
Vulnerability: Data retention/deletion clause not explicitly defined in existing contracts
Treatment Action: Renegotiate vendor DPA to include explicit retention and deletion SLA

Threat: Unauthorized visitor access to office housing employee workstations
Vulnerability: Visitor management process is informal (sign-in register only
Owner: Formally accept residual risk; low-impact given cloud-only data storage, no on-prem servers
